title: Taxi Drivers
description: Drive a motor vehicle to transport passengers on an unplanned basis and charge a fare, usually based on a meter.

tasks.text: Collect fares or vouchers from passengers, and make change or issue receipts as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Collecting fares physically from customers

dwas.name: Collect fares or payment from customers.

tasks.text: Communicate with dispatchers by radio, telephone, or computer to exchange information and receive requests for passenger service.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Vehicle movement coordination is real-time physical

dwas.name: Communicate with others to coordinate vehicle movement.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft incident reports; human verifies facts and liability

tasks.text: Determine fares based on trip distances and times, using taximeters and fee schedules, and announce fares to passengers.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Transport info lookup automatable; live assistance human

dwas.name: Provide transportation information to passengers or customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Drive taxicabs or privately owned vehicles to transport passengers.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving passenger vehicles needs real-world control

dwas.name: Drive passenger vehicles.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Follow relevant safety regulations and state laws governing vehicle operation, and ensure that passengers follow safety regulations.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI can guide safety procedures but human executes driving

dwas.name: Follow safety procedures for vehicle operation.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Notify dispatchers or company mechanics of vehicle problems.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reporting malfunctions is structured information relay

dwas.name: Report vehicle or equipment malfunctions.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Perform minor vehicle repairs, such as cleaning spark plugs, or take vehicles to mechanics for servicing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical vehicle maintenance work

dwas.name: Maintain vehicles in good working condition.

tasks.text: Perform routine vehicle maintenance, such as regulating tire pressure and adding gasoline, oil, and water.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical vehicle maintenance work

dwas.name: Maintain vehicles in good working condition.

tasks.text: Pick up passengers at prearranged locations, at taxi stands, or by cruising streets in high-traffic areas.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving passenger vehicles needs real-world control

dwas.name: Drive passenger vehicles.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Provide passengers with assistance entering and exiting vehicles, and help them with any luggage.
Provide passengers with information or advice about the local area, points of interest, hotels, or restaurants.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Transport info lookup automatable; live assistance human

dwas.name: Provide transportation information to passengers or customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Report to taxicab services or garages to receive vehicle assignments.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Receiving instructions is passive; AI can parse and relay

dwas.name: Receive information or instructions for performing work assignments.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Test vehicle equipment, such as lights, brakes, horns, or windshield wipers, to ensure proper operation.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Vehicle inspection is physical on-site work

tasks.text: Turn the taximeter on when passengers enter the cab, and turn it off when they reach the final destination.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Cost calculation from structured inputs

dwas.name: Calculate costs of goods or services.

tasks.text: Vacuum and clean interiors and wash and polish exteriors of automobiles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on washing of vehicle surfaces and parts
